user_query: I'm a small business owner and I'm looking for ways to improve my online presence. Can you provide me with tips on search engine optimization (SEO) and social media marketing? It would be helpful to see examples of successful marketing campaigns and websites.

TaskList.description: Research and gather information on effective search engine optimization (SEO) strategies.
Compile a list of best practices for social media marketing tailored for small businesses.
Find and analyze examples of successful marketing campaigns from similar businesses.
Search for and provide case studies of successful websites in your industry.
Create a comprehensive guide combining SEO tips, social media marketing strategies, and case studies.
